Overview

Chiayi is a city in Chiayi with a population of 265,000. A city in southern Taiwan, known as a gateway to Alishan National Scenic Area and for its cultural heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
